caption: This is tonkotsu ramen, featuring a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and chopped green onions. Served in a white bowl with red checkered trim, it rests on a tray under bright, even lighting.

segments_info.text: The tray is light orange, smooth, slightly curved, with a glossy finish reflecting ambient light.
The chashu pork is a round, light brown slice with a glossy surface and visible grill marks.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is pale yellow, glossy, and clear, holding thin noodles and green onions.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red checkered pattern and "Sugakira" text along its rim.
A metallic spoon with a smooth, reflective surface and slightly rounded, tapered end.
